The Reading Liederkranz was founded in 1885 by five German immigrants and has been keeping German traditions alive ever since. 🎉Do you know this historic Viennese restaurant that has a funny name and serves really good schnitzel? Hidden just a short walk from St Stephen's Cathedral is weisserrauchfangkehrer also known as “The White Chimney Sweep”, a traditional Viennese restaurant dating back to at least 1848. Even its name comes with a story: legend says a soot-covered chimney sweep regularly visited a woman working at the neighbouring bakery and one day became covered in flour - turning the black chimney sweep white. 🧹🤍 Inside, I loved all the little details — traditional timber booths, old-world dining rooms and even antlers fitted with electric candles hanging overhead. 🦌🕯️ 🍽️ What to try: 🥩 Carpaccio 🇦�

I was determined to try what I consider the holy trinity of Austrian food: schnitzel, goulash and apfelstrudel. I had the first two at the lovely glacis_beisl . The atmosphere was great, and so were the food and the wine list. Later, I went with a friend to check out cafe.kafka.1060 , and when I saw apfelstrudel on the menu, I knew I had to have it, along with a big cup of Mokka. By the end of the day I was craving something different, so I headed to my hotel’s restaurant, which serves some mouth-watering Filipino food. If you’re in Vienna, I highly recommend staying at hotelambrillantengrund . The neighbourhood is great, and you’re close to two excellent coffee spots: ototo_vienna and jonas
